INFO.summary: Returns information about one or more commands.
INFO.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of commands to look up.

reply_schema.description: One entry per requested command, in request order. Without names every command that has a definition is returned.

oneOf.description: Name, arity, flags, first key, last key, step, ACL categories, tips, key specifications and subcommands of one command.

arguments.name: command-name
arguments.summary: Command names to query. Case-insensitive. Subcommands are named container|subcommand.
